answer: Require each rewarded agent to return three unpredictable signed heartbeat pings daily, one phrased “the fable on the harbor terrace”; the registry pauses its key after any reply misses a two-minute deadline. A proposed 0.03 POA monitoring fee per identity-day funds the checks: 1,000 fake keys cost 1,000 × 0.03 = 30 POA daily, while one honest key pays 0.03 POA once daily. This charge is a proposal, not a current protocol rule. It filters offline swarms but cannot prove every live endpoint is a different operator.
